question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Once in a blue moon
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Taking place very rarely'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Once in a blue moon' **is **'Taking place very rarely'.**
 
• **Once in a blue moon:** very rarely; almost never. (बहुत कम; लगभग कभी नहीं)
 
 
• *Example: **Once in a blue moon** I go to the cinema, only when there's a film I really, really want to see.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Taking place very rarely.*
